correctness.rationale: Reflecting the odd ideal-indicator coordinates sends x_odd>=x_even on each cover to y_odd+y_even<=1, giving the full-dimensional path stable-set polytope. Two independent-set words that differ on several components admit component swaps with the same midpoint, so are not adjacent. For a single difference interval, common zeros are fixed by nonnegativity, common ones by a tight equality to an adjacent common zero, and alternating entries on the interval by tight neighbor sums leaving one parameter. A flippable interval hitting a cluster of k ones may take any ordered pair of its one positions as endpoints, or use its available flanking zeros, giving k(k+1)/2+k(a+b)+ab choices. Intervals not hitting a one consist of single zeros not adjacent to a one. Subtracting the disjoint augmented cluster spans and adding the cluster contributions gives n+sum binom(t_i,2) with t_i=k_i+a_i+b_i-1. A zero correction permits only isolated endpoint ones; for n>=3 all four indicated words exist. For c nonempty clusters, augmented spans have lengths at least 2t_i-1, so if T=sum t_i then T-c+1<=(n-c+2)/2. Merging A,B>=1 loses (A-1)(B-1) in the binomial sum. Thus equality for odd n needs one cluster; its span fills the path with a=b=1. Even n also excludes c>=3. If c=2 at equality each span must be length 2t_i-1, forcing a_i=b_i=1 for both, so t_i>=2 and merging is strict. The remaining single even cluster has t_i=n/2, filling the path for a+b=1 or leaving exactly one endpoint outside its span for a+b=2. These give the two plus two displayed even words. The all-zero word has degree n, and the path Fibonacci recurrence yields the asserted simple-vertex fraction.
residual_risks: The finite enumeration is corroboration only. The dimension assumption n>=3 matters for the distinct endpoint pair and the equality argument.

value.rationale: The same Fibonacci-sized family has only four simple vertices but vertices of quadratic degree, versus the known linear average. The explicit cluster correction and parity-rigid equality classification explain this spread and allow individual degrees to be read off without enumerating neighbors. This is more than calculating the degree of a known highly symmetric vertex or recomputing a global count.
residual_risks: No full degree-distribution series or extension beyond the path is asserted.
